old: - **Marquise, Eyrie and Alliance cost:** Activate **one matching crafting piece for every icon**. The piece's suit is **the suit of its clearing**. Marquise activate workshops, Eyrie roosts, Alliance sympathy. Combine eligible pieces as needed, but **each piece may activate only once per turn**.

- **Vagabond cost:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged hammer for every icon** to activate the pawn. Its **current clearing's suit must match every icon on the card**. The pawn may activate repeatedly, but each icon still needs its own hammer payment. One clearing cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit/mouse icons.
new: - **Marquise, Eyrie and Alliance cost:** For **each icon**, activate **one workshop, roost or sympathy in a clearing matching that icon's suit**, respectively. A crafting piece gets its suit from its clearing. Combine eligible pieces as needed, but **each piece may activate only once per turn**.

- **Vagabond cost and reuse:** The pawn **may activate repeatedly in a turn**. For each icon, exhaust **one face-up, undamaged hammer**, and the pawn's **current clearing must match every icon on the card**. Reusing the pawn never waives the hammer payment per icon. One clearing cannot pay mixed fox/rabbit/mouse icons.

old: **Birdsong:** Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:
new: **Birdsong:** Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:

old: 2. **Slip (optional):** Move to adjacent clearing or forest, exhausting **no boots**, even into hostile warriors. Ignore all effects preventing movement **out of** a clearing. Forest adjacency follows map rules, including Winter river.
new: 2. **Slip (optional):** Move to an adjacent clearing or forest, exhausting **no boots**, even into hostile warriors. Ignore all effects preventing movement **out of** a clearing. **Forest adjacency for Slip:** a forest is adjacent to clearings touching it without crossing a printed path, and to forests separated by one printed path. On Winter, the river also divides forests as paths do.
**Allied benefits:** Aid gains two VP, warriors may accompany movement, and participating warriors increase the attacking rolled-hit limit as follows:

old: - **Attack:** **Maximum rolled hits = the participating Allied warriors plus all your undamaged swords.** At the start of battle **as attacker**, you may treat warriors of **one** Allied faction there as your own for that battle. They can join against a different enemy; you cannot use an ally's warriors to attack that ally itself.
new: - **Attack with an increased hit limit:** At the start of battle **as attacker**, you may treat warriors of **one** Allied faction in the battle clearing as your own. **Add those warriors to all your undamaged swords to determine your maximum rolled hits**. They can join against a different enemy; you cannot use an ally's warriors to attack that ally itself.
